marketingLayout.footer: AI-ETL — multi-agent ETL framework, auditable code.

landing.heroTitleLine2: The agents build it — you audit it.
landing.heroSubtitle: A natural-language specification becomes extraction, cleaning, and loading of heterogeneous data. Every step generates real, reviewable Python code — not a chat answer that disappears when you close the tab.
landing.ctaPrimary: Sign in and run a pipeline
landing.whyTitle: “Why not just upload the spreadsheet to a chat and ask?”
landing.whyBody: Fair question. For a single file and a one-off question, a generic Code Interpreter already handles it — and it's free. AI-ETL exists for where that stops working.

differentiators.title: Heterogeneous multi-source, not one file at a time
differentiators.body: CSV, a real connection to Postgres/MySQL/MongoDB, authenticated REST, and PDF/DOCX in a single spec — one agent decides how to combine them. You can't paste that into a chat.

differentiators.title: An auditable, persisted pipeline, not an ephemeral answer
differentiators.body: Every run generates real code — Transformer, Analyst, Science — saved, reviewable, versionable. It survives closing the tab; a chat answer doesn't.

differentiators.title: API-first, not chat-first
differentiators.body: The pipeline is a callable, schedulable endpoint you can integrate into another system — data infrastructure, not a conversation someone has to remember to repeat every week.

differentiators.title: Governance and tenant isolation
differentiators.body: Sensitive data never passes through a third party's uncontrolled chat: tenant isolation, a sandboxed execution with a timeout, and an audit log of every action every agent takes.

landing.howTitle: From raw data to a recommendation, a pyramid of agents
landing.howBody: Nine specialized agents, each with a single responsibility — the pipeline's state passes from one to the next, never hidden inside a black box.
landing.dualTitle: Built for two people at the same company
landing.dualOperatorTitle: Whoever builds the report by hand today
landing.dualOperatorBody: Configures the source, writes the spec, audits the generated code before trusting it. Reads Python/pandas — doesn't need to write it from scratch every week.
landing.dualExecTitle: Whoever receives the result, configures nothing
landing.dualExecBody: Wants the answer and the recommendation, without becoming hostage to a number the AI might have made up — because someone on the team could already audit where it came from.
landing.techTitle: Built for production, not just a demo
techFacts: Multi-agent orchestration via LangGraph, explicit state
Generated code runs in an isolated sandbox, with a timeout
Tenant isolation with Row-Level Security in Postgres
Automatic retry + health monitoring for scheduled runs
Output validation: the result is checked before it reaches you
Self-assessed SOC2 readiness and a formal data policy (LGPD/GDPR)
landing.finalCtaTitle: Stop reconciling sources by hand every week
